summary: sadie sits down with laura martin, a certified ibs nutrition consultant and founder of healing to happy, to talk about the gut-brain connection and how mental and physical health are intertwined. they discuss what happens to your body when you're chronically depressed or anxious—how fight-or-flight mode impacts digestion, hormones, and organs—and why healing often requires you to take radical responsibility for yourself. laura shares practical advice on building nutrition routines, why consistent meals matter more than fasting, and how to set small, achievable goals instead of overwhelming yourself. the conversation is honest about how hard it is to show up for yourself, but also how empowering it feels when you do.
